title: Grocery stores near Mission Dolores for meal prep

entries.query_str: cheap grocery stores near mission dolores / soma for weekly meal prep (rice, chicken, frozen veg, eggs)
entries.answer:
Good budget options around the Mission and SoMa [1][2]:
- **Discount grocery chains with SoMa locations** — usually the cheapest for staples like rice, eggs and frozen vegetables.
- **Independent produce markets on Mission Street (16th–24th)** — very cheap fruit and vegetables, good for weekly bulk buys.
- **Large-format supermarkets near the SoMa/Mission edge** — wider selection, frequent sales on chicken thighs.
- **Warehouse club** (membership) south of Market — worth it for bulk rice, frozen chicken and eggs if you have space and a way to carry it [2].
Tip: produce on Mission Street plus staples from a discount chain usually beats one-stop shopping on price [1].
